eps.d: Barney, Lindsey and Radzi host the first show of 2016. We go backstage at the Sports Personality of the Year awards and there's a look at the best bits of the show from 2015.
Barney heads to Blackpool and explores rays currently under threat in the wild. Lindsey goes down the deepest sewage tunnel in the UK.
Barney chats to Tim Peake. Angellica Bell reveals the Book Award winners and Mary Poppins gives a performance in the studio.

eps.t: A Batmobile, a Kung Fu Panda and a Wave Runner!
eps.d: Lindsey continues in her Sport Relief challenge. There's a behind the scenes look at the new Kung Fu Panda movie, a ride in the Batmobile and a performance from Lawson.

Live from the Velodrom in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Blue Peter present a special edition for Sports Relief. In this episode, find out how Blue Peter's Lindsey Russell, 'The Wave Runner', does as she takes on one of the programme's most challenging tasks for Sports Relief. Elsewhere Barney shows where the money raised by Sports Relief goes.
A special following Lindsey Russell as she undergoes her Sport Relief challenge.

eps.t: The Walk That Changed the World
eps.d: In 1965 Martin Luther King led a march between the cities of Selma and Montgomery, Alabama USA. The marchers faced violence, intimidation and difficult conditions, but over the course of that 50 mile walk, thousands of people joined to raise awareness around the world and bring about huge changes to the rights of black people in the US.

eps.t: Get Your Team GB Sport Badge!

eps.d: This episode of Blue Peter is a fan club takeover, where viewers can control the show via the Blue Peter Fan Club. There are live online votes, viewer comments and a chance for you and your friends to become Fans of the Month! So if you've got your badge, the most important question is, are you part of the fan club yet?

Radzi takes to the skies to join in a flypast over Buckingham Palace to celebrate the Queen's 90th Birthday. A football freestyler attempts a new world record. Also, Barney takes on the art of scratching with a world-famous DJ and is challenged to a solo performance with BBC Philharmonic orchestra.

The Blue Peter team kick-start the summer badge baton relay, where they challenge viewers to earn all their Blue Peter badges, starting with the blue badge! To celebrate, Lindsey and Radzi get a head for heights by being strapped to a plane and attempt a wing walking challenge involving passing a baton to each other! Will they succeed?

eps.t: Go Green and Get Your Badge!

eps.d: Barney, Lindsey and Radzi each attempt to break their very own record, involving planes, badges and straws! Lindsey puts the new five pound super-note to the test and Barney commemorates 350 years since the Great Fire of London.

Celebrate Roald Dahl's 100th anniversary with a fantabulous Blue Peter special. The team try to recreate the science from his famous books. Also, the cast of Charlie and the Chocolate Factory perform in the studio. Phizz-whizzing!

The team are joined in the studio by a host of Olympians to inspire viewers to earn their sport badge. We continue Lindsey's sailing journey off the Isle of Wight, Barney gets some tips from an up-and-coming young darts player and the cast of the new Disney show, The Lodge, show off their singing and dancing moves.

eps.t: Jeff Kinney and the Wimpy Kid!

eps.d: It's a Children in Need spectacular as Barney, Lindsey and Radzi run, row and cycle to the ultimate bake sale in their Extreme Try-athlon. Pop megastar Olly Murs performs his latest single. Plus someone will get goo-ed. Who? You decide!
Radzi goes behind the scenes of Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, and the team are joined in the studio by some fantastic beasts of their own.
Children's magazine with information, topical items and performance.

Children's magazine with information, topical items and performance. Barney and Radzi compete at the European Curling Championships, Tom Fletcher tells some Festive Fibs and Nick James (AKA Hank Zipzer) gets messy answering viewers' questions. Plus, find out who has been nominated for Young Sports Personality of the Year 2016.

In this special Christmas edition, children from local schools will be singing a carol live in studio and the final light on Blue Peter's famous Advent crown will be lit. The cast of Chitty Chitty Bang Bang will perform a musical number, and Barney and Radzi will learn all about everyone's favourite festive vegetable… sprouts.
Barney, Lindsey and Radzi pick some of their favourite moments from a jam-packed 2016.
Lindsey and Radzi look back on some epic Blue Peter flying challenges.

Blue Peter celebrates its new blue badge design with an incredible live performance. Also, catch all the backstage action from Sports Personality of the Year 2016 and Gary Barlow's brand new talent show, Let it Shine!

eps.t: The Vamps and a Brand New Competition!
eps.d: Blue Peter turns purple as the team unveil the new look purple badge which is awarded for reviewing the show. Plus music from The Vamps. Jessica Ennis-Hill is in the studio to talk about a brand new competition.

It's the Blue Peter Book Awards 2017. Who will be victorious in the Best Book with Facts and Best Story categories? To announce the winners Barney, Lindsey and Radzi are joined by young readers, rapper Doc Brown and... A giant puppet elephant.

eps.t: Tim Peake and a Space Make

eps.d: It's the Blue Peter make and bake special! Just in time for Easter, artist Jon Burgerman makes some fun egg splats, see how to make some edible emoji faces and emoji poos, and Barney enters a cake competition!

Radzi and Lindsey take on a zip-wire challenge, testing the scientific principles of friction. Lindsey gets involved with some lambing, and singer-songwriter JP Cooper performs his single September Song.

Find out who won the London 2017 Mascot Competition and see their design take shape. Also, Radzi has the time of his life as he heads behind the scenes at one of the world's biggest sporting events, Wrestlemania!
Blue Peter launches a brand new competition and it's all about... dragons! Kimberly Wyatt talks about her new books and Radzi tries to leap and roll his way to a new parkour world record.

Barney cleans some acoustic mushrooms at the Royal Albert Hall, Lindsey's back in the Blue Peter garden to spruce it up for spring! UK's Eurovision hopeful, Lucie Jones, performs her song, Never Give Up On You. Also, knights in shining armour showcase their jousting skills!

Lindsey faces her biggest fear - sharks! Plus the team head behind the scenes at the Eurovision Song Contest and count down to the deadline of the Blue Peter Design a Dragon competition. Only one week to go!
Learn how to make your own Shelley costume courtesy of a Blue Peter fan, find out how to take the perfect penalty and see Lindsey try on a beard of bees.

The team launch a spy-inspired competition with Anthony Horowitz himself! The outgoing Children's Laureate Chris Riddell joins us in the studio with the new 2017 Children's Laureate and Barney visits the European finals of the World Scooter Championships to see young scooter stars show off their tricks.

eps.t: Code Breaker and Bye Bye Barney!
eps.d: On Barney's last ever Blue Peter, it's time to meet the winner of our amazing code breaker competition, as Barney joins them for an amazing spy day out in London.Barney also attempts a motorised dance routine in the second part of his stunt car challenge. Also, expect a few surprises for Barney along the way.

eps.t: Fan Club Takeover with Sophia Grace
eps.d: The Blue Peter fan club has taken over, with Sophia Grace performing live in the studio! There's also music from The Shades, plus we check out part two of Radzi's free-fall challenge.

Blue Peter's four-legged friend Iggy is back in the studio and is joined by CBBC's Pets Factor vets, Rory and Cheryl. Plus we check out part three of Radzi's epic Free Fall Challenge in aid of Children in Need.
It's the Blue Peter Children in Need Spectacular with Dan TDM, Pixie Lott and Pudsey Bear! Plus Radzi takes on the ultimate Children in Need challenge in Free Fall.

Blue Peter announces an amazing Worst Witch competition, Lindsey attempts to play blind cricket and author of the Jamie Johnson series, Dan Freedman pops into the studio. Plus, we announce the shortlisted books for the Blue Peter Book Awards.

Christmas is fast approaching, so warm your cockles with a performance from Nativity! The Musical. See if you've got what it takes to be the ultimate festive fan. Plus find out how many Radzis it takes to change a lightbulb 190 metres up in the air.

Blue Peter does Christmas with a 250 strong choir, a festive Boogie Storm performance and Tom Fletcher singing the jolliest song ever. Plus Lindsey helps choose the Christmas tree for 10 Downing Street and the winner of the Worst Witch competition is announced.
Blue Peter look back at an epic 2017. Relive Radzi's entire epic skydiving challeng,e from training to attempting a parachute stack with the actual RAF Falcons!

It's an orange badge special. We announce the winner of the Awesome Animation competition while launching a brand new one for Blue Peter's big birthday in its 60th year. Also, Radzi and Sport badge holder Chloe head behind the scenes at BBC's Sports Personality of the Year 2017.
Lindsey joins Awesome Animation competition winner Rory on the red carpet, and Radzi gives indoor surfing a go. Get ready for plenty of wipeouts!

It's a purple badge take over as everything is suggested by Blue Peter purple badge holders! Young comedian Ned Woodman takes centre stage for some Blue Peter LOLs. We witness some impressive flute-beat boxing skills and Lindsey takes on a speedy challenge in a dragon boat.

eps.t: 5000th Show And A Brand New Badge!
eps.d: A special edition of Blue Peter marks the show's 5000th episode, with the launch of a new Diamond Badge, designed by international fashion designer Henry Holland. The first Blue Peter badge was launched 55 years ago, and today a host of well-known faces talk about how special the Blue Peter badge is.

Lindsey is joined by Strictly star Mollie King, who takes on Blue Peter presenting duties for the day! We commemorate Vote 100 and the suffrage movement, singing sensation Calum Scott performs his new single You Are the Reason, and there's a pancake challenge!

To celebrate the Winter Olympics, Blue Peter brings you a snow sport special! Radzi takes on a very special skeleton bob challenge, Lindsey gives snowboarding a go, and the two go head to head In a speed skating race! Where better to bring you a show full of action on ice, than the Swiss Alps?

It's an ice-cold special. Find out what it means to be chilly with epic liquid nitrogen experiments. Lindsey and Radzi try ice hockey, HRVY performs in studio, and our guest presenter is the coolest guy around, Steve Backshall!

It's the launch of the Blue Peter 2018 Sport Relief totaliser with the help of internet star Chris MD! Lindsey is joined in the studio by MOTD Kickabout's Ben Cajee, Radzi goes behind the scenes at the largest science experiment in the world and impressionist, Jess Robinson, sings a song or two.

It's the Blue Peter Book Awards, so we find out which books win Best Story and Best Book with Facts, as well as who is surprised with a gold badge. Plus we see if a simple book can support the weight of two presenters on a zip wire.

eps.t: Epic Rugby and a Cheesy Bake!
eps.d: Get set for Mother's Day with Lindsey and guest presenter Tyler West from MOTD Kickabout. We slice up the Blue Peter cheese to make the ultimate breakfast in bed. Plus Lindsey heads onto the Wembley pitch for a rugby league challenge and we announce March's Fan of the Month!

eps.t: Get Ready for a Mega Sport Relief!
eps.d: Get set for Sport Relief with Radzi and guest presenter Brad from The Vamps! How will they fare when trying flatland BMX riding with record holder Matti Hemmings? Also, we kick off Lindsey and Radzi's very own Mega Mileathon challenge!

Find out how Lindsey and Radzi got on with their Sport Relief Challenge. How many steps will they be able to add to the Mega Mileathon Totaliser? There's a sneak peek behind the scenes of Sport Relief. Plus Dako Flying Angels showcase their fantastic gymnastic display skills!

eps.t: Greg James and a Diamond Delivery
eps.d: Get set for Easter with Blue Peter. We'll show you how to reuse your Easter egg boxes to build a cool automaton. Radio 1's Greg James and Chris Smith pop in to talk superheroes and Lindsey delivers the very first diamond badges.

Warning, this is the most hair-raising and exciting episode of Blue Peter ever! Radzi conducts four million volts of electricity to shoot lightning bolts from his hands. Plus four motorbike riders race around the infamous Globe of Death, and we're joined by Henry Danger himself.

eps.t: The Big Birthday Balloon and Alesha
eps.d: We announce the winner and runners-up of our Big Birthday Balloon competition, with an extra special reveal of the winning balloon! Britain's Got Talent superstar Alesha Dixon tells us all about her new book and we also announce another competition.

This episode of Blue Peter has got it all. It's jam-packed. In fact there is so much in it, we'll struggle to tell you about it all right here. Especially when we spend so much time talking about how much is on the show. Oh, we've run out of space now. Watch it!

It's a packed animal special as meerkat pups, baby tortoises and piglets are in the studio! Vets from CBBC's The Pets Factor offer advice on your pets, Radzi joins a team of toad patrollers, and animal fan Naomi Wilkinson guest presents.

Blue Peter are teaming up with the world famous RAF Aerobatic Team, the Red Arrows, to offer a once-in-a-lifetime prize. Also, basketball legends the Harlem Globetrotters visit the studio to show off their epic skills and M.O perform their latest single, Bad Vibe.

We're having a Eurovision party, as UK entry SuRie performs her song Storm in the studio. We also catch up with Scott Mills and Rylan Clark-Neal in Lisbon for the latest Eurovision update. Also, there'll be more of you receiving your diamond badges and there's another chance to enter our Flying High competition, and be in with a chance of winning a once-in-a-lifetime prize.
You won't believe your eyes when we set fire to water using miniscule science. There's live music from Una Healy. Also, George is back to kick-start the Blue Peter garden.

We take a step back in time and uncover the contents of the Blue Peter time capsule, buried 20 years ago! We also want your ideas for a new BP time capsule and author Terry Deary will be giving you some inspiration. Also, Kidz Bop join us in the studio and perform hit song New Rules.

eps.t: Fan Club Takeover with Karina Garcia
eps.d: It's a Fan Club takeover so Blue Peter are taking requests. Prepare for world-record attempts from Officially Amazing and the queen of slime herself, Karina Garcia. Also, we check in with the Blue Peter time capsule on tour.

We're celebrating 30 years of the Blue Peter green badge! We hang out with some bees in the BP garden and also learning how harmful plastics can be to our environment. Also, we make a giant eco-friendly green badge and we go behind the scenes to see how Springwatch set up their nest cameras.

Blue Peter see Radzi become a tank commander to conquer some very muddy terrain. Marvel at a seriously talented circus act from Colombia. Also, find out how to make your very own blow football stadium just in time for the 2018 FIFA World Cup.

It's competition time on Blue Peter as we give you the chance to be a part of Blue Peter history by designing our diamond time capsule! Also, Lindsey visits the iconic Blackpool Tower for a spot of maintenance and Radzi shows you how you can recycle plastic bags to make your very own kite!

Blue Peter celebrate summer in the city with a party in the BP garden. They are joined by Now United for their UK TV debut. Magician Joel is ready to wow with some incredible sleight of hand tricks. Also, Radzi attempts to ride a penny farthing. What could possibly go wrong?

eps.t: Flying High Winners and Hetty Feather
eps.d: We announce the three winners of our Flying High competition. The star of Hetty Feather, Isabel Clifton, pops into the studio, Radzi tries not to fall into the water when he attempts paddle boarding, and there's another chance to enter our new Diamond Time Capsule competition and be a part of Blue Peter history!
We're launching the brand new 2018 Sport badge. It's all about giving a new sport a go, so we're trying footgolf, netball and freestyle skateboarding. Also, we're joined by a skateboarding dog!

eps.t: Kidz Bop and the Silver Badge

eps.d: Blue Peter purple badge holders control the show. Everything has been requested on their purple badge forms, including stinky skunks, Irish dancing and a very funny comedian, Milton Jones.
Blue Peter is going green with a big beach clean, a recycled make, a special green badge giveaway and a visit to a pea farm. The green badge special couldn't get much greener.

eps.t: World Records Spectacular with Greg James
eps.d: Lindsey and Radzi attempt to break not one, not two, but three world records! All with a little help from Radio 1 Breakfast DJ Greg James. Also, Radzi takes to the track behind the scenes at the Formula One British Grand Prix.

eps.t: Creepy Crawlies and a Cool Competition
eps.d: Blue Peter's brand new competition is launching. Also, we celebrate Roald Dahl Day with creepy crawlies straight from the pages of James and the Giant Peach, blow your mind with an incredible contortion act from Cirque du Soleil and catch up with Callum and Iggy.

Magician and illusionist Jamie Raven marvels us with some amazing trickery. Lindsey attempts the art of bell ringing and Blue Peter Book Award-winning author Cressida Cowell tells us about her latest book release, The Wizards of Once: Twice Magic.

It's your last chance to earn the 2018 Sport badge. Some incredible sport personalities will be trying to earn theirs by attempting a new sport in the Blue Peter studio. Will they have what it takes to join Team Radzi? Also, Lindsey starts training for a truly epic challenge involving the big birthday balloon!

Sixty years on from Blue Peter's very first episode, past presenters return to celebrate with makes, games and lots of classic BP. Lindsey attempts to fly a hot-air balloon in the Arctic Circle, Radzi boards an aircraft carrier to create a massive birthday message, and we give Ed Sheeran a very special surprise. Also, there is music from Jonas Blue, HRVY, The Vamps and Sophie Ellis-Bextor.

We bring back Blue Peter's bring-and-buy sales and we show you how to put on the perfect one for Children in Need. Lindsey starts her latest physical endurance challenge - Swim Run, also some master UK speedcubers will be showing off their skills in the studio and putting the presenters to the test.

eps.d: The team presents a music special, talking about the songs they love, and Mwaksy Mudendaattempts a sing and sign-language challenge. Coldplay's Chris Martin, saxophonist YolanDa and chart star Anne Marie reveal how viewers can get involved and Ella Henderson performs her new single.

eps.t: Six Badges of Summer - Blue Week!
Six Badges of Summer - Purple Fan Club Week!
Six Badges of Summer - Silver Week
eps.d: The team present the last Six Badges of Summer show. Online campaigner Nikki Lilly reveals why viewers should earn their Silver Badge, Richie Driss tells his story in Draw My Life and chart star Becky Hill performs her new single Heaven on My Mind.

Life in a Zoo, Homemade Pizza and a Dancing Superstar!

eps.d: Adam visits a seal sanctuary that is working to protect the species and nurse injured seals ready for release into the wild. Meanwhile, back in studio, the BP team are joined by more wildlife to play an April Fool's game with an amazing animal twist!
Richie and Mwaksy get exclusive access to Buckingham Palace and discover how the UK is celebrating the Queen's platinum jubilee by eating delicious cake and illuminating more than 2,000 beacons.

eps.t: You're in charge of the show!
eps.d: A fan-club takeover of the programme.
BP announces the winner of the Glastonbury Festival competition live from Glastonbury itself! And the summer festival mood continues as a circus visits the Blue Peter studio.

Adam begins training for his attempt to become the first person to cycle the length of the England's largest lake on a hydrofoil bike. We have some epic rollerskaters in the studio and crown July's Fan of the Month.

eps.t: Who Has Got the Gold Badge?!
eps.d: Richie, Mwaksy, Adam and Henry look back at some of the extraordinary BP fans who have been awarded a gold badge. Featuring guest appearances from Diversity, Stormzy, Bruno Fernandez and Ruby Rube.

Want to learn a magic trick to impress your mates? Dan Rhodes has you covered as he joins Richie and Mwaksy in the Blue Peter garden for this summer special. Plus, Mwaksy suits up as a knight in shining armour for an epic jousting challenge.

Online superstar magician Joel M joins Richie and Mwaksy as a BP guest presenter! He shows how to make an amazing badge wallet to impress your friends and performs some tricks along the way. Plus jump-rope sensation Lauren Jumps shows how to skip like a pro.

The team reveal a fantastic competition that will offer the chance for one lucky viewer to design a parade outfit for Kidzfield at the iconic Glastonbury Festival! Not only will their outfit be turned into a wearable work-of-art for the parade leader, the winner will attend the festival and get to see behind the scenes as the BBC screen coverage of superstar musicians and performers to millions…

Lindsey Russell and Radzi Chinyanganya are at the European Championships in Glasgow to celebrate the Blue Peter sport badge. They have a go at wheelchair basketball, taking on Team GB in a special exhibition match, and Radzi also tries indoor surfing.

This week, Mwaksy heads to the South Coast on a fossil hunting adventure and learns how to make unforgettable gelato! Plus, we're joined in the Blue Peter studio by 10-year-old reptile expert Hollie and her collection of critters. Get ready for slithery snakes, enormous iguanas and colourful chameleons!

eps.t: World Records and Super Sports to Try!
eps.d: The team attempts to break not one, not two, but three world records live in studio! And Mwaksy and Richie drop into the skatepark for a head-to-head scoot off.

Richie and Mwaksy reveal Blue Peter's brand new sparkling Silver Badge, awarded for kindness, courage and helping others. Rita Ora, David Walliams and Greg James explain why they are championing the badge, we meet the first viewers ever to receive one, and there are live performances in the studio.

eps.t: World Records and Super Sports to Try!
World Records and Super Sports to Try!

eps.d: Super-scientist Big Manny helps kick off the Blue Peter Bonfire Night special with some explosive experiments in the studio, Richie learns how to perform with fire, and Mwaksy gets hands-on with some birds of prey.

eps.t: Christmas Cards and New Hope Club
Young Sporting Superstars and Junior Eurovision
Lunar New Year and Helicopter Rescue

eps.d: Musician and author Tom Fletcher joins the team as a very special guest in the Blue Peter studio to announce a brand new writing competition where you could become an author by writing your very own short story!

It's a Music badge takeover! Joel learns Irish folk music and Mwaksy headlines a massive arena with the world's largest school choir. Also there is a brilliant beatbox performance live in the studio, and the presenters and studio audience take to the floor themselves to give beatboxing a go!

eps.t: Behind the Scenes at Minecraft HQ!
eps.d: Mwaksy jets off to Sweden for an exclusive look around Minecraft HQ with the lucky winner of the Create Something Great competition. Back in the studio, this month's BP VIP joins Joel to perform some magnificent magic tricks, while Henry has fun on a dog agility course!

We celebrate Richie's action-packed time as Blue Peter presenter number 38 in a show full of surprises and special guests. And Richie takes on his final big challenge as he is let loose behind the wheel of a monster truck!

Meet Blue Peter presenter number 42 as they join the team in the studio for the first time and are put through their paces in an abseiling challenge. Also this year's Junior Bake Off Champion makes cake pops to get you ready for Red Nose Day.

eps.t: Red Peter – Red Nose Day Takeover!
eps.d: Blue Peter becomes Red Peter for the day as the presenters kick off the Red Nose Day celebrations in style! The team are joined by famous faces as they attempt a very messy live World Record, Joel finds out about the healing power of horses, the presenters take on an indoor skydiving challenge and singer and Strictly Come Dancing star Fleur East performs live in the studio.

Mwaksy and Abby join One Zoo Three brothers Cam, Aaron and Tyler at their zoo to hear all about their new series, OZT Goes Wild in Britain! They get hands-on with red pandas, big cats and camels, and one lucky BP VIP becomes a zookeeper for the day.

eps.t: Easter Animals and Saving Our Rivers
eps.d: Strictly winner Kelvin Fletcher joins us in the BP garden with some super-cute springtime animals, we meet a litter-busting organisation setting sail to prevent river litter, and Mwaksy teams up with some BP fans who love gardening with their grandparents!

eps.t: Exploring Our New Garden and Adventures at Sea
Doctor Who Crafts, Jamie Oliver and Space!
eps.d: We're building up to an exciting Doctor Who announcement, superstar chef Jamie Oliver helps plant the Blue Peter vegetable patch, and find out what happened when our Awesome Orbit competition winner went behind the scenes at a UK rocket launch!

eps.t: Doctor Who and Cooking with Big Zuu
Doctor Who Crafts, Jamie Oliver and Space! : Coronation Celebration!
eps.d: Ahead of HM King Charles III's coronation, Blue Peter is celebrating with a street party in the studio! BP fans will be leading the festivities and showing off their party ideas, and Joel joins the Royal Marines Band Service for a special Blue Peter performance to mark this historic day.

Eurovision fever has taken over the studio, as the presenters celebrate with a party with special guest Freya Skye and an audience of Ukrainian children. The team take a Eurovision superfan behind the scenes at the big event in Liverpool for a very special BP VIP experience, and tyhey chat to UK entry, Mae Muller, ahead of the grand final.

eps.t: Harry Potter, Magic with Stephen Mulhern and a Gold Badge
eps.d: Joel goes behind the scenes at the Harry Potter and the Cursed Child stage show to learn the secrets behind the magic. Meanwhile, Stephen Mulhern is in the studio to show us some magic of his own, and he goes head-to-head with Joel in a Guinness World Record attempt. And Abby has a very special surprise in store for superstar author Julia Donaldson.

eps.t: Silverpoint, Henry's New Dog Bed and Knights
eps.d: Mwaksy joins the cast of CBBC drama,Silverpoint, taking us for a look behind the scenes! Abby and Joel make a brand new bed out of upcycled clothes for Henry the dog, and our presenters take a trip back in time to become knights for a day!

eps.t: Pooch Party with Henry the Dog
eps.d: Celebrating five years of our Blue Peter pet, Henry the dog, with a pooch party in studio. Celebrity guests join us with their four-legged friends, Shini revisits the rescue centre where we adopted Henry, plus we meet pet expert Chloe Fuller and her super spaniel support dogs.

eps.t: Europe's Strongest Woman and Eurovision Superstars
eps.d: Europe's strongest woman attempts to break a world record. There's an update on Abby's marathon challenge. The next six reads in the Blue Peter Book Club are revealed. Music superstars and online influencers, Marcus and Martinus, visit the programme ahead of this year's Eurovision Song Contest.

eps.t: Let's Get Gardening and Baby Lambs Are Born!
Bake Off Star, BSL Celebrations and Racing Challenge
eps.d: Great British Bake Off star Tasha Stones joins us in studio as we celebrate National BSL Day, there's a performance from the amazing Sign Along With Us Choir, and Joel and Shini go head-to-head in an adrenaline-filled Stoxkart racing challenge!

eps.t: Eurovision with Olly Alexander and Joe Sugg Gets Gardening!
eps.d: Pop star Olly Alexander joins us for some fun in the studio ahead of representing the UK at this year's Eurovision Song Contest. Social media sensation Joe Sugg is in the BP Garden with some top tips on how to digitally detox and embrace the great outdoors!

eps.t: Dinosaurs, Books and Back to the Future
eps.d: CBeebies star Andy Day tells us about his latest dinosaur adventure, we go behind the scenes at Back to the Future: The Musical, and Abby faces her fear of heights at Kew Gardens by scaling some of their tallest trees!

Join us for an epic celebration of books live from the Blue Peter studio. We meet the stars of Matilda the Musical and are joined for a special performance. Find out the latest read in our Book Club, and we celebrate Blue Peter becoming the world's largest kids' book club!
Can Shini hold her nerve on the UK's fastest rollercoaster?! Plus we surprise rugby league legends Rob Burrow and Kevin Sinfield by awarding them with Blue Peter's highest accolade.

eps.t: Aladdin the Musical, Malory Towers and Animal Care

eps.d: Shini and Abby go head to head in the unique sport of Powerchair football, and Shini helps cook up some culinary delights with a Michelin star-trained chef who caters for Premier League footballers.
We celebrate World Music Day with a performance from Cat Burns, Shini takes on a musical theatre challenge, and a super-talented BP fan joins us in the studio to show off his skills on the piano!

eps.t: Football Freestyle Skills and Rosie Jones
eps.d: Comedian and children's author Rosie Jones joins us in studio, world record-breaking freestyler Ben Nuttall shows you footie skills to master at home, and Marcus Rashford is in the BP Book Club.
One of the world's top magic acts - Mario the Maker Magician - joins us for a show-stopping performance in the studio.

Abby and Shini turn up the heat as they go head-to-head in a glassblowing sculpture challenge, we explore the world of Paddington Bear, and social media baking star Eloise - aka Fitwaffle - joins us in the studio.

We're live from the Blue Peter garden celebrating summer with some super skateboarding stars. Shini finds out what it's like working at one of the busiest airports in the UK, and Abby meets 15-year-old wheelchair motocross world champion Tomas Woods.
Shini heads to Paris ahead of the biggest sporting competition in the world! Gold Blue Peter Badge holder and Olympic medallist Sky Brown gives us a skateboarding masterclass.

Abby, Joel and Shini are at Edinburgh Zoo to check out one of the BP badge attractions that you can get into for free with a Blue Peter badge! We find out what giraffes eat, weigh baby penguins and take on the challenge of becoming a rhino keeper and putting on a birds of prey display!

We continue our tour of BP badge attractions with a trip to the world's deadliest garden, and we test out the biggest play structure in the world! Plus we revisit Joel and Shini's epic Gladiator challenge and when Abby attempted dog agility!

eps.t: Time Travelling Challenge and Summer Crafts
eps.d: Joel and Shini head back in time to experience the sights and sounds of Victorian life. We turn up the heat in a blacksmith challenge, find out how buses were powered by horses and show you a super-simple game to make for some summer fun!
The team head to the National Botanic Garden of Wales to meet some wildlife, explore the biodiversity and try their hand at some traditional Welsh dancing!

eps.t: New Studio, Epic World Record Battle and Racing Challenge
eps.d: Joel, Abby, Shini and Henry reveal a brand new look for the Blue Peter studio, including new presenter Hacker T Dog! Gladiator Steel joins us for a world record challenge, and Joel races a supercar!

eps.t: Gaming Top Tips and Joel's Toughest Challenge Yet
eps.d: Top online gamers Yammy and Slogo join us for gaming masterclasses on Minecraft and Roblox. Meanwhile, Joel takes on his toughest challenge yet – scaling heights and descending cliffs to try to complete the Royal Marines Mountain Leader training.

eps.t: Creepy or Cute with Kyle Thomas and Beard of Bees Challenge
eps.d: Animal lover and social media superstar Kyle Thomas wants to prove that creepy crawlies can be cute, and Joel is challenged to wear thousands of bees on his face. Meanwhile, Shini meets one of the UK's cutest birds, and Henry gets a bath!

eps.t: Strictly Special and Brand New Competition Alert!
eps.d: Packed full of amazing celeb guests, epic challenges and lols galore!

eps.t: The Next Step Takeover and Wildlife Adventure
eps.d: The stars of The Next Step take on a dance battle in the studio and surprise a class of young fans for the ultimate dance lesson on how to attempt some moves at home. Meanwhile, Abby sets off on a sea kayaking adventure to spot some incredible wildlife!

eps.t: Silly Challenges with Harry Hill and Can Joel Become a Butler?
eps.d: Harry Hill joins us in the studio to set the presenters some silly (but hilarious) challenges! Meanwhile, Joel swaps his Blue Peter Badge for a bow tie as he trains to be a butler at one of the world's most luxurious five-star hotels!

eps.t: Bro's in Control, Pranks and What Really Happens at the Airport!
eps.d: Bro's in Control stars Adam B, Callum B and Joe Tasker go head-to-head against the Blue Peter presenters in three bonkers battles... with an unexpected prank! Shini goes behind the scenes at Heathrow Airport to discover the epic jobs and secret areas you never usually get to see!

Eleven-year-old Karis Musongole, who played young Elphaba in Wicked, flies into the studio for some Halloween fun and to show how to make creepy (but tasty!) witches' fingers. We reveal how you can get the Elphaba look at home, and don't miss our latest spooky Book Club read!

It's our spookiest special yet, as we're in a creepy castle for Halloween! Expect pumpkin carving with a Blue Peter twist and DIY costume ideas from online superstar Little Jem. And can Shini and Abby survive a night in a haunted house?

eps.t: Canadian Adventure featuring Walking with Dinosaurs Competition
eps.d: The winner of the Blue Peter Walking with Dinosaurs Competition is revealed! One lucky viewer joins Joel on a Canadian adventure in search of dinosaurs. Joel meets the firefighting teams responding to wildfires and discovers if he has what it takes to become a rancher on a farm.

TV chef Big Zuu joins Hacker, Abby and Joel in the Blue Peter studio to support Children in Need. Shini and the Blue Peter team take on an extreme bungee jump challenge, Abby visits a super sporty project, and we meet the stars from The Wicked Wizard of Oz musical.

We meet the stars of the brand new film Zootropolis 2, and Shini joins the cast of Pup School to try her hand at puppeteering! And who will be top dog as Dermot O'Leary joins us for an epic pets v presenters challenge?

eps.t: Christmas Crafts and Cake or Fake
eps.d: We show you how to make our Blue Peter Christmas card, and can our presenters spot the cakes hidden amongst the festive fakes in the studio?! Meanwhile, Abby and Joel take on a Christmas pottery challenge, and Shini lends her voice to a character in the new Pudsey animation!

eps.t: Christmas Cracker with Strictly, CBeebies and Come Alive
eps.d: Three lucky competition winners go behind the scenes on the set of Strictly Come Dancing to meet the stars of the show, Joel takes on a starring role in the CBeebies Panto, and the cast of Come Alive! The Greatest Showman Circus Spectacular join us for a show-stopping performance

Get ready for the best bits of an epic year on Blue Peter! We look back at some of our favourite moments – from Joel saddling up as a rancher in Canada and Abby discovering real dinosaur footprints on the Isle of Skye, to Shini encountering tigers in the wild in India and brand new presenter Hacker T Dog officially joining the show.

We go behind the scenes on the new series of Gladiators to see how the stars prepare for the arena. Back in the studio, the Gladiators take on the UK's strongest kid, and there's a wheelchair tennis masterclass from Paralympic champion Alfie Hewett!

Paralympic superstar Bly Twomey teaches Abby the fast-paced skills of table tennis, Joel and Shini go head-to-head in an ice hockey challenge, and Joel gets behind the wheel of a supercar for the ride of a lifetime!

Joel faces a terrifying challenge when he joins the Team GB bobsleigh team and hurtles down the track at incredible speeds! We hit the slopes to try adaptive skiing, and figure skating stars Lilah Fear and Lewis Gibson invite us onto the ice.

The cast of Horrible Histories – The Concert bring history to life with songs and silly sketches in the studio. Shini takes on a red-hot challenge stepping into the boots of a firefighter, and find out how to turn homegrown food into a tasty treat!

eps.t: Lunar New Year, Starlight Express and Pancakes
eps.d: We celebrate Lunar New Year with martial arts moves in the studio, Joel, Shini and Abby take on a pancake art challenge, and we go behind the scenes of the skating spectacular West End musical Starlight Express!

eps.t: Six the Musical and The Next Step
eps.d: The queens from Six the Musical perform a show-stopping song and a Guess Who's Singing challenge! We go behind the scenes on The Next Step tour for dance secrets and rehearsal exclusives, and Abby meets the animals on JB Gill's farm.

The stars of Operation Ouch join us for gross facts and an epic quiz about the human body. Meanwhile, Shini finds out what it's really like to be a young farmer and gets the incredible opportunity to see a lamb being born up close.

Celebrate World Book Day with Harry Potter's Weasley Twins, James and Oliver Phelps, who taste-test iconic foods from famous books! Check out the latest space-themed book from astronaut Tim Peake, and find out how to doodle, Diary of a Wimpy Kid-style!
We launch a brand new competition, and Team Blue Peter go head-to-head with Team Radio 1 in an epic music quiz! TV chef and rapper Big Zuu cooks up a treat to celebrate Eid.

Blue Peter becomes Red Peter for Red Nose Day! The stars of Gladiators: Epic Pranks and Saturday Mash-Up join us for a last-to-laugh challenge, and Joel attempts springboard diving to help raise money.

eps.t: Super Dogs and the Magic Faraway Tree
eps.d: We celebrate seven years of Blue Peter pet dog Henry and meet incredible rescue dogs trained to take on the toughest mountains. We also meet the cast of new film The Magic Faraway Tree.

Join Joel, Abby and Shini on an epic Northern Ireland adventure! Joel finds out how potatoes are turned into crisps and invents his very own brand new flavour! Shini learns how to care for horses before saddling up for a ride along the stunning coastline, and we find out who is crowned the ultimate Celtic warrior.

eps.t: Deadly Takeover and Royal Green Badge
eps.d: Steve Backshall joins for a deadly quiz, His Majesty the King is awarded a Blue Peter Green Badge, Abby discovers some deadly flowers and fungi, and it's the latest read from the Blue Peter Book Club.

Shini and Abby go access-all-areas with Aaron, Tyler and Cam from One Zoo Three as they learn about life at the zoo. Shini meets the capybaras and joins vets caring for the elephants, while Abby is on night patrol and in charge of bedtime for a baby rhino.

Joel and Abby take on a high-speed rally racing challenge, and as excitement builds around the Eurovision Song Contest, UK contender Look Mum No Computer and 2025 entry Remember Monday join us in studio!

eps.t: Matilda the Musical, Protecting Animals and Odd Squad
eps.d: The RSC production of Matilda the Musical performs When I Grow Up, and Hacker meets the stars of new film The Mandalorian and Grogu! Meanwhile, Abby gets a starring role in the new series of Odd Squad.

eps.t: Radio 1's Big Weekend Competition Winner Revealed!
eps.d: Blue Peter goes access all areas at Radio 1's Big Weekend with our lucky competition winner! Joel, Abby and Shini try DIY festival make-up looks, and The Adventures of Rap Kid by MC Grammar is the latest read in the Blue Peter Book Club.

eps.t: Football World Cup Takeover with SV2 and Manny
eps.d: SV2 and Manny celebrate the World Cup on Blue Peter with skills, tricks and iconic goal recreations! The footballing duo go head-to-head as they take on challenges and look at legendary World Cup moments – don't miss it!

eps.t: KIDZ BOP, Irish Dance Superstar and Women's World Cup Cricket!
eps.d: KIDZ BOP perform live, a young Irish dancing world champion shows off his skills and gets the surprise of a lifetime, and Shini takes on a challenge with the stars of this year's T20 Women's Cricket World Cup.

eps.t: Toy Story 5, My Neighbour Totoro and Queen of the Jungle Scarlett Moffatt
eps.d: Hacker meets the stars of Toy Story 5, while Abby takes two superfans behind the scenes of West End production My Neighbour Totoro, with exclusive access to the magical puppets which bring the story to life. Also, Queen of the Jungle, Scarlett Moffatt, joins us in the studio!

eps.t: Football Freestyle and an Epic Superhero Challenge
eps.d: Football freestyle star Ben Nuttall goes head-to-head with a rising young champion in an epic skills battle that is packed with tricks and plenty of surprises! Joel sets out on a mission to become a superhero - the first two challenges he faces are flying and attempting to create his very own superhero costume!

eps.t: Joel's Final Challenge - He's in Charge!
eps.d: Joel attempts something that has never been done before for his final epic challenge – climbing Portsmouth's Spinnaker Tower! Back in the studio, Joel tries every job on the show, and we look back at his best bits.

eps.t: Harry Styles and Access All Areas at Wimbledon
eps.d: Shini meets one of the biggest pop stars on the planet, Harry Styles, during his record-breaking run of shows at Wembley Stadium! Plus, we go behind the scenes at Wimbledon to try all the jobs that keep the tournament on track.

eps.t: Robert Irwin's Wildlife Adventure and Football Fun
eps.d: Wildlife superstar Robert Irwin puts his skills to the test with a photography challenge. We check out the latest read in the Blue Peter Book Club and find out how to make some tasty football biscuits!
Joel takes on an epic superhero challenge as he attempts something that has never been done before - climbing one of the UK's tallest buildings Spidey-style!

eps.t: High School Musical and Shini's Cheerleading Challenge
eps.d: The cast of the new UK tour of High School Musical perform a show-stopping song, and Shini takes on a challenge to find out if she has what it takes to perform live in a cheerleading competition!

eps.t: Strictly Come Dancing and Shini's Cheer Challenge Finale!
eps.d: Strictly's Katya and Rhys go head-to-head in a boys v girls dance battle and show how to make tasty glitter ball snacks. Can Shini pull off a show-stopping performance in her big cheer competition?

eps.t: Shaun the Sheep, Pets and Deadly Crafts
eps.d: Hacker goes behind the scenes of Shaun the Sheep's new movie, Steve Backshall makes a cute pencil topper, and Kyle Thomas tests the BP team's animal knowledge.

eps.t: Lion King Musical Challenge, Magic and Cooking Battles
eps.d: Shini goes behind the scenes with the cast of The Lion King musical to find out if she has what it takes to join them live on stage! And musical magician Rafferty Coope performs in the studio..

eps.t: Abby's Epic Rowing Challenge and Mind-Blowing Science
eps.d: Abby competes in the British Rowing Club Championships - can she pull off a gold medal performance? And Brainiac Live perform some mind-blowing science experiments.

eps.t: Epic World Records and Shini's Skyscraper Challenge
eps.d: Two super talented spaniels and one of the strongest women in the world attempt to smash world records in the studio. Shini attempts to clean the windows of the tallest building in the UK.
It's Halloween in the studio with Abby, Shini and Hacker, who show how to recreate make-up looks and make a haunted house.
Shini, Abby and Hacker celebrate Halloween at a spooktacular theme park, testing which attraction is scariest and showing us how to make tasty vampire teeth treats!
